ggbscript:
A = Slider[-5, 5, 0.08333333333333333, 1, 300, false, true, false]
SetValue[A, 1]
SetLineThickness[A, 2]
ShowLabel[A, true]
SetVisibleInView[A, 1, true]
SetFilling[A, 0.1]
SetLabelMode[A, 1]

b = Slider[-6, 6, 0.1, 1, 300, false, true, false]
SetValue[b, 2]
SetLineThickness[b, 2]
ShowLabel[b, true]
SetVisibleInView[b, 1, true]
SetFilling[b, 0.1]
SetLabelMode[b, 1]

c = Slider[-12, 12, 0.2, 1, 300, false, true, false]
SetValue[c, 1]
SetLineThickness[c, 2]
ShowLabel[c, true]
SetVisibleInView[c, 1, true]
SetFilling[c, 0.1]
SetLabelMode[c, 1]

g(x) = (A * (x - b)^(3)) + c
ShowLabel[g, false]
SetVisibleInView[g, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[g, 0]
SetLineThickness[g, 2]

xint = Root[g]
ShowLabel[xint, true]
SetVisibleInView[xint, 1, true]
SetColor[xint, "#404040"]
SetLabelMode[xint, 0]
SetPointSize[xint, 3]

TP = Extremum[g]
ShowLabel[TP, false]
SetVisibleInView[TP, 1, true]
SetColor[TP, "#404040"]
SetLabelMode[TP, 0]
SetPointSize[TP, 3]

yint = Intersect[g,yAxis,1]
ShowLabel[yint, true]
SetVisibleInView[yint, 1, true]
SetColor[yint, "#404040"]
SetLabelMode[yint, 0]
SetPointSize[yint, 3]

text6 = Text["General Equation is "]
ShowLabel[text6, true]
SetVisibleInView[text6, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[text6, 0]

text5 = FormulaText[" y = A(x-b)^{3} + c"]
ShowLabel[text5, true]
SetVisibleInView[text5, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[text5, 0]

text7 = Text["Adjust A, b and c values by moving the
position of the dots on the sliders below"]
ShowLabel[text7, true]
SetVisibleInView[text7, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[text7, 0]

text3 = Text["Equation of the basic curve is y = x^3 or"]
ShowLabel[text3, false]
SetVisibleInView[text3, 1, true]
SetColor[text3, "#0000cc"]
SetLabelMode[text3, 0]

text4 = FormulaText["y = 1(x - 0)^3+0 "]
ShowLabel[text4, false]
SetVisibleInView[text4, 1, true]
SetColor[text4, "#0000cc"]
SetLabelMode[text4, 0]

basic(x) = x^(3)
ShowLabel[basic, true]
SetVisibleInView[basic, 1, true]
SetColor[basic, "#0000cc"]
SetLabelMode[basic, 0]
SetLineThickness[basic, 3]

SPI = TurningPoint[g]
ShowLabel[SPI, true]
SetVisibleInView[SPI, 1, true]
SetColor[SPI, "#ff0000"]
SetLabelMode[SPI, 0]
SetPointSize[SPI, 3]

text1 = FormulaText["y=" + A + "(x -" + b + ")^{3}" + " + " + c]
ShowLabel[text1, true]
SetVisibleInView[text1, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[text1, 0]

BasicSPI = TurningPoint[basic]
ShowLabel[BasicSPI, true]
SetVisibleInView[BasicSPI, 1, true]
SetColor[BasicSPI, "#0000cc"]
SetLabelMode[BasicSPI, 0]
SetPointSize[BasicSPI, 3]

text2 = Text["SPI = " + SPI]
ShowLabel[text2, false]
SetVisibleInView[text2, 1, true]
SetColor[text2, "#ff0000"]
SetLabelMode[text2, 0]

text8 = Text["x intercept = " + xint + " and y intercept = " + yint]
ShowLabel[text8, false]
SetVisibleInView[text8, 1, true]
SetLabelMode[text8, 0]

text9 = Text["Its SPI is at (0, 0)"]
ShowLabel[text9, false]
SetVisibleInView[text9, 1, true]
SetColor[text9, "#0000cc"]
SetLabelMode[text9, 0]
